notes: Measured from the recorded footage. noise_sigma: high-frequency standard deviation of a flat table patch. flicker: frame-to-frame brightness variation of that patch. auto_exposure / exposure_target: how the wrist frames' mean brightness tracks the unexposed simulated ones. sharpen: unsharp-mask strength at which the strongest edges are as steep as in the footage (the overhead webcam sharpens; the wrist value is a compromise, its footage has more fine texture than the simulation). jpeg_quality: the recorder's. latency: calibration/latency.py.
